Beginning of the blue trail by Bartek Zobek
landmark
Dieser Ort dient als Ausgangspunkt am Mount Kadam und markiert den Beginn der von Bartek Zobek kartierten malerischen blauen Wanderroute.
A Mount Kadam hegyén található pont a Bartek Zobek által feltérképezett festői kék túraútvonal kiindulópontja.
Servind ca punct de plecare pe Muntele Kadam, acest loc marchează începutul traseului pitoresc marcat cu albastru de Bartek Zobek.
Serving as a trailhead on Mount Kadam, this spot marks the starting point of the scenic blue hiking route mapped by Bartek Zobek.
State Lodge
landmark

A hivatalos kormányzati rezidenciaként szolgáló kapchorwai State Lodge Kelet-Uganda drámai, dombos táján fekszik.
Servind ca refugiu guvernamental oficial, Kapchorwa State Lodge este situată în peisajul dramatic și deluros din estul Ugandei.
Serving as an official government retreat, the Kapchorwa State Lodge is set against the dramatic, hilly landscape of eastern Uganda.
Sipi Main Fall Viewpoint
natural
Dieser Aussichtspunkt bietet das spektakulärste Panorama und blickt direkt auf den tosenden Sturz des Sipi-Hauptwasserfalls.
A leglátványosabb panorámát nyújtó kilátópontról egyenesen a fő Sipi-vízesés dübörgő zuhatagára lehet rálátni.
Oferind cea mai spectaculoasă panoramă, acest punct de observație are vedere directă la căderea zgomotoasă a cascadei principale Sipi.
Offering the most spectacular panorama, this vantage point directly overlooks the roaring plunge of the main Sipi waterfall.
Main Sipi Fall Viewpoint
natural
Dieser ausgewiesene Aussichtsbereich am Rand der Klippe lässt Besucher den Nebel der gewaltigen Sipi-Wasserfälle spüren.
A szikla peremén elhelyezkedő kijelölt kilátóhelyen a látogatók érezhetik a hatalmas Sipi-vízesés permetét.
Situată de-a lungul marginii stâncii, această zonă de observare desemnată permite vizitatorilor să simtă ceața marilor cascade Sipi.
Positioned along the cliff edge, this designated viewing area lets visitors feel the mist from the thunderous Sipi falls.
Sipi Woman Craft Shop
cultural

A vízesések közelében működő helyi női szövetkezet által fenntartott művészeti központ autentikus fonott kosarakat és ugandai gyöngyfűzéseket árul.
Condus de o cooperativă locală de femei din apropierea cascadelor, acest centru de arte vinde coșuri împletite autentice și mărgele ugandeze.
Run by a local women's cooperative near the waterfalls, this arts center sells authentic woven baskets and traditional Ugandan beadwork.

museum

Ez az Mbalében található múzeum Semei Kakungulu ugandai történelmi személyiség egykori rezidenciáját és történelmi tárgyait őrzi.
Situat în Mbale, acest muzeu păstrează fosta reședință și artefactele istorice ale figurii istorice ugandeze Semei Kakungulu.
Situated in Mbale, this museum preserves the former residence and historical artifacts of the prominent Ugandan historical figure Semei Kakungulu.
swimming pool area
recreational

Nestled in the city of Mbale, this tiled outdoor recreational complex offers families a refreshing aquatic escape during the hot dry season.
Bulucheke (BULU 001)
natural

Ez a magasan fekvő kilátóállomás pazar kilátást nyújt a Mount Elgon lejtőin elterülő teraszos kávéültetvényekre.
Această stație de observare la mare altitudine oferă perspective ample asupra plantațiilor de cafea terasate de pe pantele Muntelui Elgon.
This high-altitude viewing station provides sweeping perspectives over the lush, terraced coffee plantations clinging to the slopes of Mount Elgon.
NAKATSI control point 001
natural

Serving as an elevated topographical marker, this open viewpoint looks out over the misty valleys and rich agricultural lands of the Elgon foothills.
Wagagai
natural
Wagagai ist der höchste Gipfel des Mount Elgon, eines erloschenen Schildvulkans im Mount Elgon Nationalpark.
A Wagagai a Mount Elgon, a Mount Elgon Nemzeti Parkban található kialudt pajzsvulkán legmagasabb csúcsa.
Wagagai este cel mai înalt vârf al Muntelui Elgon, un vulcan scut stins situat în Parcul Național Muntele Elgon.
Wagagai is the highest peak of Mount Elgon, an extinct shield volcano located in Mount Elgon National Park.
Sudek
natural
Sudek ist ein markanter vulkanischer Gipfel im vielfältigen Hochgebirgslebensraum des Mount Elgon-Massivs.
A Sudek egy kiemelkedő vulkáni csúcs a Mount Elgon masszívum változatos, nagy tengerszint feletti magasságú élőhelyén.
Sudek este un vârf vulcanic proeminent situat în habitatul divers de mare altitudine al masivului Muntele Elgon.
Sudek is a prominent volcanic peak situated within the diverse high-altitude habitat of the Mount Elgon massif.
Kitum Cave
natural
Die Kitum-Höhle ist eine tiefe Vulkanhöhle im Mount-Elgon-Steilhang, die berühmt dafür ist, regelmäßig von Elefanten auf der Suche nach Salz aufgesucht zu werden.
A Kitum-barlang egy mély vulkáni barlang a Mount Elgon meredek lejtőjén, amely arról híres, hogy a sót kereső elefántok rendszeresen látogatják.
Peștera Kitum este o peșteră vulcanică adâncă din escarpamentul Muntelui Elgon, renumită pentru faptul că este vizitată în mod regulat de elefanți în căutare de sare.
Kitum Cave is a deep volcanic cave within the Mount Elgon escarpment, famous for being regularly visited by elephants seeking salt.
Mount Elgon National Park
natural
Der Mount Elgon Nationalpark schützt die schroffen Hänge und dichten Bergwälder eines riesigen erloschenen Schildvulkans.
A Mount Elgon Nemzeti Park egy hatalmas kialudt pajzsvulkán zord lejtőit és sűrű hegyi erdeit védi.
Parcul Național Muntele Elgon protejează pantele accidentate și pădurile montane dense ale unui masiv vulcan scut stins.
Mount Elgon National Park protects the rugged slopes and dense montane forests of a massive extinct shield volcano.
